reason: Same-light original/R02/R05/R06 native comparisons show R06 softens the hard wrinkled wrist/cuff transition while retaining more sleeve belly, rolled lip and forearm volume than over-faired R05. realChanges.method: Visual compromise after exact-pixel R06-parent/R02/R05 comparison. A 900-step intrinsic fairing radius keeps more actual original cuff/forearm volume and cloth curvature than R05 while softening the hard R06-parent fold. Same original hand cup and lip transition as R02, no broad unroll or triangle repulsion. Every original indexed triangle/vertex/UV remains.
realChanges.notAddedOrDeleted: No separate hand, cap/cover, overlay, hidden-face deletion, remesh or head/other-hand/leg/bearing edit.

remainingVisibleAndPhysicalLimits: 101 new strict local sleeve-self pairs and25 source-inherited pairs remain; coplanar/tangential contacts/global injectivity are not proven.
Actual lower cuff still has a pointed crest and long upturned lip; hand retains source mudra and still differs from HD finger/gesture anatomy.

R06 is a visual compromise; no additional blanket fairing should be used merely to lower the count. A future independent original-boundary local cloth retopology/rebuild is authorized if thickness still reads wrong.
